I replied to Pree in a thread on their message in #central-team: the store is **Pine Crossing**.

The answer comes from Pree's own message in #central-team on Jun 9. They wrote that Pine Crossing's morning receiver could only see the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and ask support to reproduce the problem.

I told Pree I couldn't find a site code or address for Pine Crossing in anything they can see. The thread also doesn't say whether the fix was made. Pree is a member of #central-team, so everything in the reply came from what they can already see there.
